title: Batch 158 — eight additional in-place Hebrew source enrichments after ten public body inspections
review_method: Manual public web/open inspection of ten accessible original-Hebrew publisher bodies. Eight distinct additional body passages were paraphrased in place; two opened passages were not added because the current propositions already cover the available content. No search snippet or title was used as content.

excluded_candidates.reason: הגוף הקצר הזמין כבר מיוצג בפרופוזיציה הקיימת; לא נמצא מקטע נוסף מובחן.
המקטע הנוסף שנפתח כבר מיוצג בפרופוזיציה הקיימת; לא נוספה פרופוזיציה חוזרת.

metrics_note: Baseline from Answer Quality Gate run 44286037624 after batch157: 1522 answer-eligible unique sources, 854 content-verified unique sources and 3915 answer-eligible propositions. This is a branch-workspace measurement, not public main metrics. Batch158 adds eight propositions to existing families only; actual post-review metrics await full reconciliation.

deduplication_check.note: No new AID, URL or Evidence Family was created. Eight existing canonical identities were enriched in place and two were rechecked without additions; the full identity/eligibility audit is deferred to reconciliation.
